name: KOOS
description: 5-subscale self-report questionnaire for knee conditions. Each subscale scored 0–100 (100 = no symptoms). No total score — interpret subscale profile.
copyright: Free (academic/clinical); commercial users require MAPI Trust license
shirleySays: ICC 0.75–0.93 per subscale. MDC varies (~8–13 pts). MCID: 8–10 pts (most subscales). Normed in knee OA, ACL reconstruction, meniscal injury, chondral lesions, TKA. Short forms: KOOS-12, KOOS-JR (for TKA), KOOS-Child.

scoring.mcidNote: 8–10 pts MCID per subscale; lower score = more problems
